summary: Operator 2026 rates: confirmed 20A $45 / 50A $63 (30A $58), holiday 3-night minimum, Good Sam and military discounts, water + electric. Changed sewer true -> false ('We have no sewer at the sites'). Added 50-amp, Passport America, Staylist booking, camp store. The $45 20-amp sites are 'designed for Tents and Small RVs' but Staylist offers them to a 23-ft Class C, so the base stays $45 (under the $50 gate; the 30-amp $58 would be over, no gateway within 40 km). Seasonal sites exist ($2,000/season) beside posted daily rates, so the long-stay test passes. Note trimmed of hookup/site/booking/rating text. Not stated: site count, lengths, laundry, season.
flags: Price gate, borderline: the $45 base is the 20-amp class the operator describes as 'designed for Tents and Small RVs' (the booking engine does offer it to a 23-ft Class C). The next class, 30-amp, is $58, over the $50 line with no gateway within 40 km (nearest Rochester 108 km) and no family stays. A human may want to decide whether the 20-amp class counts for EKKO.
